```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(R2jags)
library(coda)
library(psych)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_2_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_2")
results_path <- file.path(study_2_path, "results")
models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models")
figure_path <- file.path(study_2_path, "figures")

set.seed(7386)

ges_summary <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "ges_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ges_long_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "ges_long_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))
```

```{r}
# Restrict to the Study 2 analytic sample
ges_study <- ges_summary %>%
  filter(
    setup == "SOLO",
    !excluded,
    !participant.code %in% c("l6gxo7po", "n0ndmyka"))
```

```{r}
# GES availability and participant-level descriptives

ges_availability <- ges_study %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id,
    participant.code,
    gender,
    ges_score) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    ges_available = !is.na(ges_score))

ges_availability %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_ges_available = sum(ges_available),
    prop_ges_available = mean(ges_available),
    percent_ges_available =
      100 * mean(ges_available))

ges_availability %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_ges_available = sum(ges_available),
    prop_ges_available = mean(ges_available),
    percent_ges_available =
      100 * mean(ges_available),
    .groups = "drop")

ges_descriptive_sample <- ges_availability %>%
  filter(ges_available)

ges_descriptive_sample %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),
    mean_ges = mean(ges_score),
    sd_ges = sd(ges_score))

ges_descriptive_sample %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),
    mean_ges = mean(ges_score),
    sd_ges = sd(ges_score),
    .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
# Distribution plots
ges_descriptive_sample  %>%
  ggplot(aes(gender, ges_score, fill = gender)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Study 2 GES by gender",
    x = NULL,
    y = "GES (mean item score)")

ges_descriptive_sample  %>%
  ggplot(aes(ges_score, fill = gender)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Study 2 GES density",
    x = "GES (mean item score)",
    y = "Density")
```

```{r}
# Bayesian t-test: gender differences
params <- c(
  "mu", "sigma", "delta", "a", "men", "women",
  "mu_prior", "sigma_prior", "delta_prior", "a_prior", "men_prior", "women_prior")

ges_ttest_data <- ges_descriptive_sample %>%
  filter(
    gender %in% c("Female", "Male"))

data_list <- list(
  x = ges_ttest_data %>% filter(gender == "Female") %>% pull(ges_score),
  y = ges_ttest_data %>% filter(gender == "Male") %>% pull(ges_score),
  N1 = sum(ges_ttest_data$gender == "Female"),
  N2 = sum(ges_ttest_data$gender == "Male"))

samples_path <- file.path(results_path, "s2_jags_ges_ttest.rds")

if (file.exists(samples_path)) {
  samples_ges <- readRDS(samples_path)
} else {
  samples_ges <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = params,
    model.file = file.path(models_path, "t-test_GES.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 25000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1)
  saveRDS(samples_ges, samples_path)}

samples_ges
```

```{r}
# Posterior summary and BF01
s_all <- as.matrix(as.mcmc(samples_ges))
delta_draws <- s_all[, "delta"]

d_post <- density(delta_draws)
post_at_0 <- approx(
  d_post$x,
  d_post$y,
  xout = 0)$y

prior_at_0 <- dt(0, df = 1)

bf01 <- post_at_0 / prior_at_0

bf01
1 / bf01

plot_prior_posterior(
  draws = s_all,
  posterior_name = "delta",
  prior_name = "delta_prior",
  xlab = "delta",
  vline = 0,
  title = "Study 2 prior vs posterior: GES gender effect",
  central_prob = 0.95)
```

```{r}
# Posterior group means
tibble(
  women = s_all[, "women"],
  men = s_all[, "men"]) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "group", values_to = "mu") %>%
  ggplot(aes(mu, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Study 2 posterior group means for GES",
    x = "GES mean",
    y = "Density")
```


## Calculate Cronbach's alpha

```{r}
ges_items_long <- ges_long_clean %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "SOLO", participant.code != "l6gxo7po", participant.code != "n0ndmyka")

ges_items_long %>% count(variable)

ges_items_long %>%
  group_by(participant.code) %>%
  summarise(
    n_items = n_distinct(variable),
    n_answered = sum(!is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  count(n_items, n_answered)

ges_items_wide <- ges_items_long %>%
  dplyr::select(participant.code, variable, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) %>%
  arrange(participant.code)

ges_item_data <- ges_items_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("q")) %>%
  dplyr::select(order(parse_number(names(.))))

ges_alpha <- psych::alpha(
  ges_item_data,
  check.keys = FALSE,
  warnings = TRUE)

ges_alpha
```
